question.text: Explain how religious beliefs shaped everyday life in one ancient society you have studied.
question.topicLabel: Features of ancient societies: religion and belief

concepts: the limits of the surviving evidence
relationships: religious belief shapes daily practice, not only formal ceremony
religious authority shapes social and family roles
belief and material life influence each other, rather than one simply following the other
accomplish: holds one judgement about how far religious belief reached into ordinary life, rather than listing the areas it touched
explains at least one area of everyday life deeply enough to show the mechanism, instead of covering several at surface level
draws on more than one kind of source and says what each one proves
separates what the sources show from what they leave unclear
requirements.syllabus: Features of ancient societies: religion, belief and their place in daily life. The society is the student's own choice and is never named here.
